title: Nymph
tagline: Anonymous, ENS-verified discussion platform for web3 orgs with zk proofs & privacy first interest.
description:
Nymph is a privacy-first, anonymous communication platform designed for Web3 communities and organisations, leveraging zk proofs, ENS identities and on-chain verifiable randomness. The platform allows users to verify their membership in a group or organisation without revealing their actual identity, enabling safe, trustless and anonymous conversations.

Key Features:
- Anonymous ENS / Organisation Verification
- Users authenticate using Sign-In With Ethereum (SIWE, ERC-4361) and we generate a zk-proof ownership of an ENS domain or membership in a specific organisation.
- zk circuits validate membership without revealing the user’s wallet or personal identity.

Public & Private Channels
-Public Feed: Anyone can post or comment anonymously with a label like someone from base.eth or blocsoc.eth
- Private Channels: Access restricted to verified members of a specific ENS domain or organisation.
- Anonymous Colour Identity (Pyth Entropy) - In private channels, each user is assigned a unique, randomly generated colour as a persistent pseudonymous identity, each colour generated by a hex code using Pyth Entropy.

zkCookies – Privacy-Preserving Interest Tracking
- Users’ interactions (comments, posts) are tokenized into keywords.
- Each keyword’s count is stored as a hashed zkState, ensuring the server never sees raw data.
- Aggregated hashes allow the platform to generate interest-based recommendations or contextual content without compromising anonymity.
